description: This file defines a Java class 'ReadableOrderTotalPopulator' that extends 'AbstractDataPopulator'. It is responsible for converting 'OrderTotal' objects into 'ReadableOrderTotal' representations, populating various fields using provided services like 'PricingService' and utility classes for localization. The class includes dependency setters and implements the 'populate' method to perform the transformation with validation and exception handling.
